He survived not by turning to the crime that surrounded him, but by adapting, hustling as a tourist guide and relying on the kindness of the community who took him in.  Now out of the shadows, he’s exposing the global systems and parents who allowed a vulnerable foreign child to vanish onto the streets. He’s back to claim the Injustment and compensation he was denied for decades.  It’s a journey into a world few see, an unexpected story about life, trauma, and the grit it takes to survive after being abandoned by the very systems and people that were supposed to protect you. This is music that may come across as light-footed, but possesses astonishing depth. At Hurricane 2026, RIKAS are likely to hit the spot just as the festival day is slowly really getting into its stride. Meanwhile, his neighbors keep a close eye on him, especially the elderly M’nouar, marked by the terrible memories of the Algerian War. He sees everything and everyone with suspicion. As far as he is concerned, Mahfoud has no good intentions—he may even be involved in subversive activities.  Naturally, it does not help that Mahfoud is in a relationship with Samia, a young psychiatrist who has returned to the country after studying in Belgium. She challenges local norms and breaks taboos that unsettle those around her.  In the end, Mahfoud manages to obtain a visa to attend the international fair. His invention wins a prize, and when he returns home, he receives a very different kind of welcome.

Looking back at history, what can we learn?⁣  "Before Crystallization" tells the story of how people were treated before sugarcane became a symbol of sweetness.⁣ "Before Crystallization" discusses what efforts we still need to make before memory becomes a collective identity.⁣ Let the Erlin Sugarcane Farmers' Association lead the way, as we travel through time together and begin a century of reflection.⁣

title: Homeless Blues
overview: Prague 9 has taken a different approach. The district has offered homeless residents modest housing in construction units along with work opportunities within the community. Instead of treating homelessness as a social puzzle, this initiative turns people without homes into active members of the community who participate in public life. The daily struggle for survival is replaced by caring for animals, maintaining public spaces, and developing friendships and romantic relationships. Will this program help them build independent lives, or will they simply become dependent on another form of support? This time-lapse collective portrait of people at the bottom of the economic ladder raises important questions about how society views poverty, responsibility, and solidarity.

title: Le Corsaire
overview: Since its 1856 premiere at the Paris Opera, Le Corsaire has been regarded as one of the most impressive narrative ballets of the 19th century. The work became particularly popular in the versions by Jules Perrot and Marius Petipa and, of course, through the spectacular “Le Corsaire pas de deux,” made world-famous by Dame Margot Fonteyn and Rudolf Nureyev.  For this first performance of the ballet in full at the storied Wiener Staatsoper in 2016, Wiener Staatsballett director Manuel Legris—after a 23-year tenure as an étoile dancer of the Paris Opera Ballet!—choreographed a new version based largely on the rich French and Russian performance traditions. Action, music, choreography, scenery and costumes are carefully combined into a new overall picture which focuses on the high points of the colorful events surrounding the leading couple of Conrad and Medora, sublimely danced by Robert Gabdullin and Maria Yakovleva!

title: Noticiero Mujer, Hoy
overview: Starting in 1972, Law 19327 came into effect in Peru. Its main feature was the mandatory exhibition of Peruvian films, which had to accompany feature films in daily screenings across all cinemas in the country. This provision enabled film students, as well as professionals already working in production and filmmaking, to create their own works—generating both employment and a learning environment. Many of today’s established filmmakers began their careers under the opportunities provided by this law. MUJER, HOY (WOMAN, TODAY), composed of four short films also with three segments each and a total runtime of approximately five minutes, was shot on 35mm color film. It was one of the first newsreels to focus exclusively on cultural content. The diverse appearances and contributions of notable figures in MUJER, HOY collections represent a valuable resource for researchers across various disciplines.

title: 云初令
overview: In her previous life, Yun Chu, the daughter of a noble family, married into a poor household. She devoted herself to her husband's rise, shielding his family from every storm, only to be repaid with betrayal, poisoning, and the massacre of her entire clan. She swore that if she were ever given another life, she would make the traitors suffer a hundredfold. Breaking free from an endless cycle of fate at the cost of everything, she is reborn. This time, she wields gentleness as her blade and cold resolve as her shield, advancing step by step as she secretly stirs the currents of court politics. She seeks vengeance against those who wronged her and, amid the chaos of a troubled era, to live for herself. Destiny and intrigue, deep love and revenge intertwine. A fated encounter gives rise to her dominion. She turns the world upside down; he defies heaven to rewrite fate. As the winds of the realm rise, a single command from Yun Chu is enough to decide the balance of the world.

title: 风月不相关
overview: Guan Qing Yue is a valiant heroine who fought bravely on the battlefield alongside her father, earning accolades for her contributions to the defense of Li State. However, after her father Guan Cang Hai was wrongfully accused during a battle, their family faced severe injustices. Upon retiring, she relocated to Ye Country, adopting the name Guan Feng Yue, and established Menghuilou to assist those impacted by war. After the storm subsided, Guan Feng Yue transformed Menghui Tower into Menghui Academy. The two joined forces to create a peaceful and prosperous age for the people and finally stayed together for a long time.

title: 红尘四合
overview: On the night of the Mid-Autumn Festival, the fox general Yuwen Hong Ce was ambushed in the Sailun Valley, and his entire army was wiped out. He endured and hibernated, vowing to find out the truth about the corruption of military equipment. On the same night, Wen Ding Yi, the daughter of a high-ranking official, lost her family because her father was falsely accused of collaborating with the enemy. She changed her name to Mu Xiao Shu and disguised herself as a man to become the executioner's apprentice. Eight years later, on the execution ground, Xiao Shu herself almost died under the knife, but was fortunately saved by Hong Ce. Little did he know that he had saved the daughter of a guilty minister who had had an affair with Wu Di, and little did she know that the one she was staring at was the son of the royal family who had caused her entire family to be wiped out.

title: Due Time
overview: A girl named Sofia always prioritises her studies and is determined to complete her art coursework before the 9 p.m. deadline. However, as she struggles to find inspiration, her mind goes blank. Meanwhile, her friend Alice encourages her to take a break and enjoy life, believing it will be beneficial to her. Sofia eventually completes her art coursework successfully but what helped her in the end? Her imagination or reality?

Belalang gets the idea to change Pak Belalang's behavior when he accidentally discovers the village's pet animal that has been stolen. Belalang suggests that Pak Belalang disguise himself as a fortune teller.

However, due to lack of evidence, the police face difficulty in finding out who else is involved in the crime. Furthermore, bound by the criminal's loyalty oath, no matter what happens, they will not betray each other's names.

title: Ouagadougou – portraits de dieux
overview: Ouagadougou – Portraits of Gods (1992) explores contemporary Burkina Faso through the intertwined journeys of two Burkinabè men and a Belgian painter. As Christianity, Islam, and ancestral beliefs coexist in everyday life, the film reveals how the sacred is woven into ordinary existence. Blending intimate observation with visual portraiture, Benoît Lamy offers a poetic reflection on identity, spirituality, and the invisible forces that shape human lives.

title: SHUSH
tagline: When a peaceful library is disrupted by a loud customer, Charlène, a young woman struggling with anger issues, takes matters into her own hands.

title: 折月亮
overview: Shy and socially anxious Yun Li enrolls in graduate school to prove her independence and unexpectedly reunites with her high school crush, the brilliant Fu Shi Ze. Years later, Fu Shi Ze, now a renowned researcher, is determined to win Yun Li back when she returns from abroad. Through growth and perseverance, they find their way back to each other.

title: 这一秒过火
overview: In Shanghai during the Republic of China era, Murong Qing Yi, the youngest son of a warlord, was abused by his adoptive father due to a case of mistaken identity. He meets Ren Su Su, and together they are determined to fight against powerful enemies. Set in 1930s Republican-era Shanghai, their love story unfolds amidst political tension and danger.

title: 花戎
overview: Wei Zhi, a young woman seen as a jinx since birth, attends the coming-of-age ceremony to detect immortality root bones. Her studies lead her to encounter Yan Yue, the sun deity, who discovers that she is the only one capable of breaking through his impenetrable aura. As a bond forms between them, they uncover a shared past — Wei Zhi is the reincarnation of a powerful phoenix spirit that Yan Yue is duty-bound to destroy.

title: 雀骨
overview: Bound by a marriage ordained by royal edict, cold commander Xiao Wu Yi and the cunning daughter of the Grand Tutor, Xie Jia Yu, are brought together not for love but to serve hidden agendas. From a contractual couple to lifelong partners, from suspicion and conflict to love and unity, they go from rivals in ambition to comrades in life.

title: 谁杀了画眉鸟
overview: Thirteen years after her family was torn apart in childhood, Li Fuyuan returns to Huachang County to avenge her wrongfully killed brother. There, she meets Lu Yanchong, the seemingly frivolous county magistrate. As his true identity and motives come to light, the two move from mutual suspicion to working side by side to solve a series of baffling cases, uncovering the truth behind the Thrush Case from thirteen years ago.

title: 月明千里
overview: Li Yao Ying is a princess exiled to a distant land through a forced political marriage. She is saved by the reclusive Sultan Gu also known as Luo Jia, who is devoted to the Gods. Under the desert moon, a single glance sparks a destined love. As war and chaos threaten their world, they fight side by side, proving that even in the darkest times, love can light the way.

title: Para Kay Kalia
overview: A family mourns the loss of a mother and wife. Kalia (14) is a transgender girl coming into her own and embracing a new chapter in her life. Kiko (43), a widowed tricycle driver, remains bound to traditional beliefs and the lingering memories of his late wife.  As prom night approaches, Kalia dreams of wearing her mother's gown. When Kiko discovers her intention, he reacts violently and tears the dress away from her. Faced with his daughter's truth, he must choose between holding on to the past or opening himself to the changes that life inevitably brings.  Kiko eventually realizes the depth of their bond and decides to mend the gown. Though his unaccustomed hands are wounded in the process, he perseveres for the sake of his child. Later, as Kalia prepares to leave for school, Kiko hands her a piece of paper—a signed consent form. The film culminates with Kiko watching Kalia in her gown, placing a plastic crown upon her head: his quiet yet profound gesture of acceptance.

title: 沉香重华
overview: Yan Dan regains her memories and discovers that Ying Yuan is the one who wiped out her memories and turned her into a spirit, sending her to the Mortal Realm. Lord Ying Yuan, who took human form as Tang Zhou, only needs one more divine artifact to repair his celestial vessel and return to the Heavenly realm as the Sovereign Lord. Will he reveal the anonymous figure who backed the evil doings, and will he and Yan Dan overcome the misunderstandings between them?

title: 沉香如屑
overview: Yan Dan and her twin sister Zhi Xi are the sole descendants of the ancient tribe the Four-Leaved Lotus. Yan Dan's entire being is a treasure trove of medicines. She and twin sister Zhi Xi transformed into human form a century before while attending the Queen Mother's Feast, but Yan Dan faced the greatest trial of her life - the love trial. Falling in love with Lord Ying Yuan resulted in her wasting the following 900 years trying to forget him.

title: 云归喜事
overview: Reborn as a humble official, former hero Yun Ye uses his brilliance in statecraft to navigate national crises while balancing family and love. His journey to restore peace and stability becomes a tale of resilience and legendary heroism.

title: 云秀行
overview: A 2026 Chinese xianxia historical romance adapted from the Japanese novel series Saiunkoku Monogatari. A young woman navigates the complex world of politics and romance in an ancient court setting.

overview: The second part of Love Like the Galaxy. Ling Bu Yi and Cheng Shao Shang navigate greater trials as they deepen their bond and forge a union that shines even in the brightest of galaxies.

title: An Mháthair
overview: When confronted with the young man who took her son away from her, a grieving mother must stop him before he strikes again.

title: 星汉罂烂
overview: Cheng Shao Shang, a girl raised without proper care, meets the empire's greatest general Ling Bu Yi. Their relationship grows from conflict to love as they navigate family politics and war in ancient China.

title: 颜心记
overview: A face-blind noble Jiang Xin Bai and a cursed traveling doctor Yan Nan Xing embark on a journey through the martial world. As they face challenges, their fated love proves true connection goes beyond appearances.

title: 封影燃梅香
overview: A peculiar girl with dual souls, An Jiu, transforms from an ordinary girl into a royal female special agent. She encounters a young general and companions, growing amidst familial grudges and national enmities.

title: 东宫
overview: Director's cut of Goodbye My Princess (2019). Xiao Feng, princess of the Western Liang Kingdom, finds herself at the center of a dangerous political conflict when Li Cheng Yin, the youngest Li prince, is sent to assassinate her family and steal her heart. This director's cut features never-before-aired scenes and episodes, adding to the suspense of the original series.

title: 哦！我的皇帝陛下
overview: Luo Feifei, a 21st-century doctor, is unexpectedly transported to the mysterious ancient nation of Huang Dao, the kingdom of the Zodiac. There, she meets the Emperor Bei Tangyi, who shares the same appearance as her idol. A romantic comedy about a modern woman navigating life and love in an ancient zodiac kingdom.

title: 吉星高照
overview: Adapted from the xianxia novel Heaven Official's Blessing by Mo Xiang Tong Xiu. The story follows Xie Lian, a fallen god who has been cast down from the heavens twice and now works as a scrap collector. After ascending to godhood for a third time, he encounters Hua Cheng, the ghost king who strikes fear into gods and demons alike. A story of devotion spanning 800 years.

title: 皓衣行
overview: Mo Ran is the young disciple of the most powerful cultivator in the world, Chu Wan Ning. After dying at the end of his first life as a ruthless tyrant, Mo Ran is reborn and given a second chance. He resolves to be a better person and protect those he loves.

title: 许我耀眼
overview: The glamorous anchor Xu Yan and urban elite Shen Hao Ming are an enviable couple, but their differing backgrounds create tension in their relationship. After a conflict, Xu Yan breaks free, only for Shen Hao Ming to realize he has always loved her and vows to win her back. Over time, they shed their facades and rediscover each other.

title: On The Line
overview: Robert a solitary student, must navigate an unpredictable night to save his brother.
tagline: Risk Everything

title: 聊斋
overview: A mysterious beauty's severed head appears in the bustling marketplace. A fox spirit, trapped in the treacherous depths of human desire, struggles to escape her fate. In this world where the boundaries between flesh and fantasy blur, ancient magic and human folly collide, revealing that even the most lifeless things may hunger for a soul. Adapted from the classical Chinese stories collection Liao Zhai Zhi Yi by Pu Song Ling.

title: 招摇
overview: After being ambushed by the ten immortal sects while trying to steal the Wanjun Sword, Lu Zhao Yao dies, believing her ally, Li Chen Lan, the demon king's son, is responsible. Five years later, Zhao Yao returns as a spirit to seek revenge, but as she trains under Li Chen Lan, her feelings for him begin to change.

title: 三生无殇
overview: On the eve of her wedding, Shang You, a young woman from the Holy Spirit Tribe, unexpectedly rescues Si Yuan, the Dark Lord of the Underworld Tribe. However, on her wedding day, her entire tribe is wiped out. To resurrect her people, Shang You infiltrates the Underworld Tribe and unexpectedly falls in love with her enemy, only to later discover that her real enemy was someone else all along.

title: Dropout Presents an Improvised Reunion for a Movie that Doesn’t Exist
original_title: Dropout Presents an Improvised Reunion for a Movie that Doesn’t Exist
overview: For 25 years, the Tribeca Festival has been known for reuniting the cast and crews of some of the greatest films ever made — classics such as Taxi Driver, Scarface, and Schindler’s List. But at Dropout and Vulture’s “Improvised Reunion for a Movie that Doesn’t Exist,” one of the highlights of Vulture Festival at Tribeca Festival, a gathering was held for one of the greatest films never made. That movie was The Sound of the Squid, as invented on the fly by Dropout stars Brennan Lee Mulligan, Izzy Roland, Zac Oyama, and Lou Wilson, who were in conversation with Blank Check podcast host Griffin Newman. The improvisers played the film’s writer, producer, and stars; the director, we learned, is in prison.  This panel was recorded live at the SVA Theater in New York on June 14, 2026 as part of Vulture Festival at Tribeca Festival.

title: 月明千里

As war and chaos threaten their world, Li Yao Ying and Luo Jia fight side by side, proving that even in the darkest times, love can light the way.

title: Alice Kampung Baru

Alice (Amelia Christie) and her mother, May (Sazzy Falak) have just moved to Kampung Baru to seek a fresh start with hopes of escaping her problems and her past life. Alice befriends Ria (Serra Kamal) and Siska (Sharifah Rose), teenagers in Kampung Baru who have their own problems. Ria faces problems with her hot-tempered stepfather and Siska is so poor that she has to steal food. As a girl who has just arrived in the big city, Alice feels sympathy for her new friends' situations and wants to help solve their problems. At the same time, Alice becomes interested in a troubled young man in her neighborhood named Raz (Aniq Durar).

title: Seloka Asmara Buat Kemboja (TV1)
overview: Kemboja, a university lecturer, is friends with Asyraf, an owner of an international advertising company who prioritizes English and Western culture. Asyraf visits Kemboja's house to meet his family. Kemboja's family is rich with Malay culture in their daily lives. Asyraf feels uncomfortable and thinks he has been made a fool of by Kemboja's family. Kemboja is disappointed with Asyraf for giving in so easily. Kemboja is also disappointed with his father for the way he treated Asyraf. Kemboja enters into a cold war with his father. Dato Meor gives Asyraf a second chance on the condition that Asyraf must understand and appreciate the Malay people within a month. Kemboja helps Asyraf attend classes in Malay history, culture and language with a professor at his university.

title: Nak Dengar Cerita Hantu?
overview: The story tells of a man who reluctantly inherits and protects a powerful spirit from his father. However, over time he gradually grows fond of the spirit under his care. After many years, as he approaches the end of his life, Pak Harun begins to realize and tries to dispose of the powerful spirit which has started to disturb the village residents. Especially when his daughter breaks off her engagement because of his protection of the spirit. Pak Harun finally disposes of the powerful spirit with the help of a religious teacher. Pak Harun eventually passes away, and his children and wife move away after his death.

title: The Cadets (Astro Ceria)
overview: ~ will be updated

title: Zuriat Dari Penjara
overview: The story of Shara, a woman who is willing to abandon her family to pursue wealth without realizing she has been deceived.

overview: # Translation  It tells the story of Iris Nur (Ezzanie Jasny), a 'diva' woman who had a dispute with Inspector Ebrahim (MK K-Clique) when her attempt to escape a reckless driving summons failed. Iris did not expect that she would meet Inspector Ebrahim again, who was appointed as the Suksis Corps Coordination Officer at her university. Later, Iris cut off contact with Inspector Ebrahim after the end of the Suksis Corps certificate presentation ceremony. Iris wants to turn over a new leaf by joining a humanitarian mission in Ijora. Without the knowledge of others, Iris actually has another agenda. Iris also did not expect that her life would change after meeting Firman there. Firman is hired by Iris's father as Iris's personal bodyguard. Who is Firman really and what will happen between the two of them?

title: In the Silence After
overview: A son returns home to care for his mother, filming the last year they will spend together.

title: The Perfect Family
overview: The Perfect Family follows 12-year-old Margot as she navigates life in a damaged household. Her parents, Mia and Jack, mask their failing marriage with moments of forced normalcy, but Margot is constantly affected by the arguments and resentment between her parents.

title: Dialog Sesudah Senja (TV2)
overview: The story follows a young man named Hasib from a broken family who experiences pressure due to conflicted feelings as he watches his mother struggle hard to ensure he successfully obtains a degree. The situation worsens when his mother is abused by his brutal father. Meanwhile, Hakim is a lecturer at a university with an apparently successful career, but in reality he is under pressure to maintain his momentum as a successful academic. This is further complicated by his fractured family when his choice to prioritize his career comes to the fore.

title: Gadis Kampung Paling Popular
overview: # Translation  The story of Maya, a beautiful village girl who loves to sing but is shy. Maya has just moved to the city and meets Safidah, a boutique worker who belongs to her uncle, who also begins to transform Maya into an urban girl known as Lady Wawa. Her mother in the village, Cik Eton, wants to marry off her daughter to a businessman in their village. However, Maya refuses. The Lady Wawa persona and her lifestyle are kept hidden from her family's knowledge. Maya's life begins as she becomes a famous YouTube star until Azad becomes aware of her. Azad secretly likes Maya and he states that the popular Lady Wawa is an example of a dishonest person. Maya, who is disheartened because Lady Wawa is actually herself, withdraws and becomes sad. Will Azad discover the truth?

title: Jangan Panjat Pagar Itu (TV1)
overview: The story of three good friends living in a senior citizen home: Rahmat, Boon and Jaya. On the occasion of Rahmat's birthday, Jaya and Boon wish to fulfill whatever request their friend makes. It turns out that Rahmat harbors a desire to be free and escape from the senior citizen home where they live. Despite their hesitation and worry about the action they are taking, the three of them decide to run away from there. They flee without bringing any identification. Their disappearance is eventually noticed by the warden of the senior citizen home. The warden has requested Inspector Betul's help to find the three of them. Various incidents occur throughout the search to track down the three friends. Finally, they are found at Che Yah's house. But who is Che Yah? What is their connection with this woman?

title: Cik Misi 123
overview: It tells the story of Oya, who is forced to enter a nursing course at her parents' insistence. At this college, Oya meets Mika, who then tries to win her heart. While they work at the hospital, a major conflict begins when Oya's ex-fiancé, Dr Aish, appears, causing Dr Aish's girlfriend, Dr Erin, to become jealous.

title: Perhentian (TV Okey)
overview: It tells the story of Pak Dollah, Hassan, Hanif and Sofia who board an express bus, but halfway through the journey, the bus they are on breaks down. They begin to tell each other their respective stories and problems.

overview: Through a game similar to the one they enjoyed as children, a young man manages to rekindle the love of life in a friend who has suffered a stroke.

They are blessed with 4 children: Harith (Syed Ali Murthada), Athirah (Aresya Rania), Uzair (Al Rayyan Ho) and Uwais (Syed Muhammad Baqir). As their children grow up, Hanim begins to suspect something different about Uzair. His development is different, Uzair does not speak and is weak in vocabulary mastery, tends to have tantrums, shows no interest in toys, sleeps late and is always energetic. The doctor confirms that Uzair is positively autistic at the age of 3 years old. Thus begins their family life shrouded in physical, financial, emotional and spiritual challenges.

title: OLIVIA
overview: After her boyfriend of four years ended their relationship, Olivia has vowed never to have anything with men, ever again. She’s emotionally outraged when she stumbles upon a stranger in the most irritating encounter.

title: Su propia ley
overview: A group of street kids are exploited by an elderly man who also manages a group of prostitutes. One of them falls in love with Magda, a prostitute and the pimp's wife, which forces him to confront the leader. In the ensuing confrontation, the leader is killed, and the young man takes over, keeping the group, the business, and the woman.

title: Bonji (TV2)
overview: Because of a grudge, Bonji, a village social media influencer, is slandered by Anonymous Village until Bonji is driven out of his village. To clear his name, Bonji is forced to investigate who the real owner of the Anonymous Village account is.

title: Facundo
overview: An old music teacher meets his death in a very particular way.

title: Bukan Sekadar Lafaz (TV3)
overview: Syikin (Wanna Ali) is a new trainee working at a famous cafe. While working, she reunites with her old school friend named Hud (Alif Satar) who serves as the supervisor at the cafe. Old memories from their school days rekindle the hidden feelings of love in Hud's heart. However, Syikin is now with a doctor named Dr Firman (Malek Mccrone). Her relationship with Dr Firman is heavily envied by her stepsister Aein (Yuna Rahim), who has feelings for Dr Firman. This jealousy drives Aein to devise an evil plan to ruin Syikin's life. Syikin is deceived by Aein's scheme, resulting in a pregnancy. Due to this suspicion, Tuan Zaman (Ahmad Idham) becomes furious and forces Syikin to marry Dr Firman to prevent scandal to their family. Dr Firman feels as though he is being manipulated and refuses Tuan Zaman's request. Realizing the situation Syikin is facing, Hud then offers himself to marry Syikin to save their family's honor.

title: Anthropos
overview: An experimental film looking at the dichotomy of the human condition - the artificial adverse to  the natural. The film explores the relationship between the natural and the artificial, and their  subsequent juxtaposition, in way of two mirrored personas who attempt to resolve their conflict.  As an experimental film, Anthropos aims to deconstruct the idea of character by expanding its  boundaries through elements of the film medium, from framing to costume design to visual effects  and overall cinematography, moulding the character to be intertwined with the cinematographics  of the film. The film reformulates the audiences emotional attachment to be a response to the  cinematographic character rather than an individual character.
tagline: An experimental film looking at the dichotomy of the human condition

title: Sempurnakah Cinta Kita
overview: Alif and Lina want to divorce, but after their best friends Ariz and Sarah die in an accident, Alif and Lina are forced to take care of their only child, Aidy.

title: Exchange
overview: A paralysed teenage boy, isolated on a private hospital ward. His life flashes before, last moments of life, with a vivid encounter with death. Is the accounted recollection forged or an authentic perspective ?

title: A Pocket Guide to Pigeon Watching
original_title: A Pocket Guide to Pigeon Watching
overview: Adapted from Rosemary Mosco’s book and shot on 16mm and Super 8, this cinematic portrait explores New York City’s enduring relationship with pigeons. Often dismissed as “flying rats,” pigeons emerge as resilient survivalists deeply tied to the city’s history. Moving through rooftop coops, city streets, and a mosaic of New York voices, the film invites us to reconsider the pigeon, soften our gaze, and recognize that coexistence is an act of choice.
tagline: A glimpse into the remarkable lives of our closest avian neighbors, and what they reveal about us.

title: Glowing
overview: GLOWING by Beth B is not just a film, but an immersive, genre-defying experience that blurs the boundaries between documentary, narrative, experimental cinema, and music video.Eight fearless artists step into the frame — their voices raw, their stories electric. As poets, musicians, and performers reveal deeply personal truths, their stories collide and intertwine, forming a powerful, living dialogue with the audience. What unfolds is not simply storytelling, but an invitation: to feel, to witness, to connect.

title: Transmisión del mando supremo : 28 de julio de 1945
original_title: Transmisión del mando supremo : 28 de julio de 1945

The ceremony was attended by national and international dignitaries, and included a speech by Dr. Manuel Prado Ugarteche before the transfer of power.

title: En la cuenca carbonífera de Oyón
original_title: En la cuenca carbonífera de Oyón

It describes his passage through the picturesque plaza of Sayán, the town in the province of Chancay where he was received and cheered in gratitude for the public services they had received. It mentions that the citizens of Churín celebrated the construction policies that had improved the road and, in gratitude, presented the president with flowers and vicuñas. During his visit to Oyón, he toured the coal mines, inaugurated the mine, and inspected the workers' camps.

title: BUNKER
overview: Bunker is a commissioned documentary that follows Damián Arabia as he recounts the unexpected odyssey of living under terrorist siege, transforming a personal testimony into an intimate reflection on fear, survival, and the fragile line between ordinary life and historical violence. Through interviews and archival material, the documentary reconstructs a state of confinement where memory becomes both shelter and battlefield, revealing how extreme events reshape not only the lives of those who endure them, but also the way they understand the world afterward.
tagline: A personal account of fear, survival, and history lived from within.

title: El presidente visita la provincia de Canta
original_title: El presidente visita la provincia de Canta

title: Mysteries and Desire: Searching the Worlds of John Rechy
original_title: Mysteries and Desire: Searching the Worlds of John Rechy
overview: Challenging the borders between autobiography, memory, history and fiction, this interactive memoir presents a diverse array of personal materials by and about John Rechy and sets them against larger collective histories of Chicano culture and the gay world. Drawing passages from all of Rechy’s published novels, it also mines the outrageous fictions that circulate around this fascinating literary figure who, as a gay icon, a Chicano writer from Texas, a dedicated bodybuilder, a gifted teacher of creative writing, and the 1997 recipient of the PEN West Lifetime Achievement Award, has long been a subject of notoriety and fantasy. Combining original artwork, video, archival documents, and recorded interviews and commentaries, it lets you move through three interrelated realms – Memories, Bodies and Cruising – each with its own daring repertoire of gestural interfaces.

title: A Simple Game

title: Forget Tosquelles!
overview: The film chronicles the life, personality, and legacy of Francesc Tosquelles, an exiled Catalan psychiatrist who pioneered institutional psychotherapy. The film explores how Tosquelles reshaped the Saint-Alban psychiatric hospital in France during World War II, blending psychoanalysis with political activism and community work.

title: YoRHa Ver.1.1

title: Pyscho
overview: Marion Crane steals $40,000 and drives toward Fairvale to be with her boyfriend, Sam. After switching cars and getting caught in a storm, she stops at the remote Bates Motel. Norman Bates, its shy owner, talks with her about his strict mother. Planning to return home, Marion is murdered in the shower by a mysterious figure. Norman hides her body and sinks her car in a swamp.  Marion’s sister Lila, Sam, and private investigator Arbogast search for her. Arbogast traces her to the motel but is killed in the Bates house. When the sheriff reveals Norman’s mother died years earlier, Lila and Sam investigate themselves. Lila discovers Mrs. Bates’ mummified corpse, and Norman—dressed as his mother—attacks her before Sam stops him. A psychiatrist explains Norman killed his mother, preserved her body, and developed a murderous “Mother” personality. Marion’s car is later recovered from the swamp.

title: Saint-Alban, une révolution psychiatrique
overview: In France, 45,000 of the 70,000 institutionalized mentally ill patients died in French psychiatric hospitals during World War II. But not in Saint-Alban. It all began with a meeting in Lozère in a medieval castle converted into a psychiatric hospital in 1821 of four young psychiatrists: Paul Balvet, Francesc Tosquelles, Lucien Bonnafé, and André Chaurand. They hid those threatened by the ruling regime—members of the Resistance and Jews—and fought against hunger and Nazi oppression.

title: The Last Straw
overview: A group of marine animals decide to clean up their part of the ocean, teaching the audience about the dangers of polution and the values of recycling along the way.

title: Pathways
overview: In a world full of noise, the next generation of musicians strive to be heard. While performance is solo, success is a profound collaboration.  Pathways humanises the journey of the classical musician, moving from the "four walls" of isolation to the spotlight of the Yamaha Music Europe Foundation competition. Featuring intimate access to the lives of applicants in Athens, Bern, and Manchester, the film explores the "balance of energy" required to sustain the arts. It captures the tension of performance, the relief of validation, and the realisation that a scholarship is more than money, it is a vital touch point in an artist's history.
tagline: Success is not a solo pursuit

title: Yeh Hai Chakkad Bakkad Bumbe Bo
original_title: Yeh Hai Chakkad Bakkad Bumbe Bo
overview: What happens when you put four mischievous children together with a dog and a monkey? Lots of fun, of course! And that's what 'Chhakkad Bakkad Bumbe Bo' (The Sensational Six) is all about - fun, adventure and learnings.

title: Love Finds You
overview: A mislabeled package convinces jewelry designer Alex she's found her ideal man, sending her and delivery driver Jack on a citywide search that helps them discover what they truly want.

title: Attihannu Mattu Kanaja
overview: Gouri, a documentary filmmaker takes a journey along with her friend. She is trying to collect material for her documentary project on instrumental music. They go to a village with the help of a schoolteacher. They travel to meet an instrumental musician, who has gone some place elsewhere to give a performance. Both are forced to stay in the village till the musician returns. Film tries to capture the human attitude when they are placed in a condition/situation/environment which is familiar and at the same time unfamiliar. As the seemingly simple yet complex situations develop, how these characters fits in to a landscape and climate as much mental as physical. Some time "vision" isn't what is visible, sound isn't exactly what is heard.

title: Toast to Italy
overview: Jenny travels to Italy for a special bottle of wine for her sister's wedding. She meets Arrigo, also looking for the famous "Love Wine" and together their search leads to a love of their own.

title: Déconnage
overview: As part of the exhibition Critical Episodes (1957-2011). MACBA Collection, Level 2 of the Museum presents two new episodes of the MACBA Collection. One of these episodes is Déconnage, a video-essay by Angela Melitopoulos and Maurizio Lazzarato that looks at the life and work of the psychiatrist Francesc Tosquelles (1912-1994). In Déconnage, one of the pioneers of critical psychiatry in post-war Europe is introduced. Anti-psychiatry is recovered here through the figure of Francesc Tosquelles: a discourse and practice that address not mental illnesses, but vital, social and ethical problems. Anti-psychiatry foresaw the dysfunctions that would eventually afflict people in contemporary societies.

title: Idô hotel: Maruhi meromero
original_title: 移動ラブ・ホテル　（秘）めろめろ
overview: A small rental car company on the outskirts of the sub-metropolitan area. The female president of this company had a secret side business. They converted the back of a light van into a luxurious love hotel, and the male employees used the van to provide mobile sex services to frustrated women who were afraid of being seen having affairs or going out. Yes, it was a mobile love hotel, and it was a huge success.

title: Tires on Wheels
overview: Dora prepares for her driving exam, but, as takes lessons in her boyfriend's old Audi, she slowly starts to realize that the root of her anxieties isn't the road itself, but, rather, the coming of age process that comes with it.

title: Kentucky State Fair Pin 2004
overview: 'Kentucky State Fair Pin 2004' is a full film by the Louisville experimental rock band Fishgills, which also doubles as a visualizer for the album of the same name.

title: SCP:Gallionic
overview: SCP:GALLIONIC is an independent animated short film following the events after a catastrophic containment breach through the eyes of Matthew Vestergaard, a simple accountant working on the outskirts of the facility, and the events leading up to said breach through Jane Vestergaard, a young researcher at the facility and Matthew's older sister. Jane is helplessly frustrated with the facility's status quo in which containment breaches seem to be a common occurrence and the loss of staff is just part of the job. She is worried this mass apathy could lead to a catastrophic containment breach and has to scramble for a solution to all of this. Matthew, on the other hand, decides to venture within the facility after said catastrophic event, with no knowledge of what happened or even what is in this place, but with the sole goal of saving his sister

title: The Lead

title: Lonely Island

Overwhelmed by the excitement and joy of creating together, they overlook the enormous risks looming ahead.On the fourth day of filming, problems crop up one after another, leaving the three at a loss. Zheng Yuan refuses to weaponize the expressions she holds dearest to her heart; Fang Chi’s tender heart may become a stumbling block on her path as an actress; meanwhile, Zhao Xin, a rookie producer, strives to safeguard their idealism amid this overwhelming chaos.When they return home exhausted, the three discover that their two kittens have vanished without a trace…

title: Cuerpo de auxiliares voluntarias en el local del Comité Central

overview: Ivo (26) is in a fragile psychological state. In search of much-needed support, he turns to his father. However, their meeting is not what Ivo had hoped for, and he leaves to make his appointment with his therapist, Lotte. Despite Lotte’s efforts, Ivo avoids talking about his father. Led by the mysterious therapist Robert and his assistant Isa, they prepare a decisive confrontation they believe Ivo must have with his father.

title: I’m not okay – Five conversations about emotional pain

overview: I'm not okay. Actually, I'm feeling really bad. In fact, I feel so bad that I want to kill myself. How do I tell my loved ones? How will they react?  That’s what 26-year-old Clara is trying to figure out through five conversations, each of which offers insight into her mental state and her relationships with those around her.

title: Cartografía

With each version of herself comes a distinct relationship with the city and cinema, and each version shares an unavoidable fate: the passing of her grandmother.

overview: In 1979, Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini led a historic revolution against the Shah of Iran. This powerful documentary explores the dramatic clash between the Imam and the Shah that ended centuries of monarchy and established the Islamic Republic of Iran.
tagline: One Imam. One Shah. One Revolution That Changed History Forever.

Stumbling upon a rural farmstead, he finds a guarded German farmer who knows no English. With a language barrier dividing them, the backpacker must discern whether this stranger is a lifeline or the threat.
tagline: What they don't know will hurt them.

title: Talking to the Wall: The Story of an American Bargain
original_title: Talking to the Wall: The Story of an American Bargain
overview: Wal-Mart's plan to build a large store in a small town is the backdrop for this sharp-edged comedy. All goes well for the corporate giant until an 11th hour citizens' rebellion resists the lure of low prices to reveal another side of the bargain—a side which paves over open land, annihilates Main Street businesses, and rolls back wages. The story goes still deeper—following, over a period of seven years, one town's decision contrasted with another town 20 miles away.
